# DataFlow Systems Q4 2024 Earnings Report

## Executive Summary

DataFlow Systems delivered exceptional financial performance in fiscal year 2024, reporting record revenue of $2.1 million, representing a robust 34.8% year-over-year growth from the prior year's $1.56 million. The company achieved net income of $161,210 with a healthy operating margin of 7.7%, demonstrating effective operational execution and cost management. This strong performance reflects DataFlow's successful penetration of the manufacturing sector and growing demand for integrated production management solutions across our core product portfolio.

## Revenue and Profitability Analysis

The company's impressive 34.8% revenue growth significantly outpaced industry averages, driven by increased adoption of our comprehensive manufacturing software suite. With current revenue reaching $2,100,808 compared to $1,558,896 in the previous year, DataFlow added $541,912 in incremental revenue. Our operating margin of 7.7% reflects disciplined expense management while investing in growth initiatives, resulting in strong bottom-line performance with net income of $161,210. The revenue per employee metric of approximately $2,135 demonstrates improving productivity across our 984-person workforce as we scale operations efficiently.

## Business Segment Performance

Our manufacturing-focused product portfolio continued to gain market traction, with particular strength in Production Planning solutions driving customer acquisition and expansion. The integrated approach across Production Planning, Maintenance, and Quality Control modules has proven highly effective in addressing manufacturers' end-to-end operational needs. Customer retention rates remained strong as existing clients expanded their DataFlow implementations, while new customer wins contributed significantly to the year's growth trajectory. Our specialized focus on manufacturing workflows has differentiated DataFlow in a competitive market and established strong customer relationships that support sustainable growth.

## Forward-Looking Guidance

Looking ahead, DataFlow Systems is well-positioned to maintain strong growth momentum given the robust pipeline of manufacturing prospects and ongoing digital transformation trends in industrial sectors. We anticipate continued revenue growth in the 25-35% range for fiscal 2025, supported by product enhancements, expanded sales capacity, and deeper market penetration. The company remains committed to maintaining healthy profitability while investing strategically in R&D and talent acquisition to support long-term market leadership. With our proven solutions and strong financial foundation, DataFlow is confident in delivering continued value creation for stakeholders while serving the evolving needs of manufacturing customers.
